integrity_notes: The stated proof is self-contained; a standalone dynamic-programming checker tests n = 2,3,4,5 against graph neighborhoods. Finite testing is not an infinite proof. All status claims refer only to self-review.
scientific_limitations: All claims are for complete single-edge subdivisions with n >= 2; no assertion about arbitrary base graphs. The historical priority of the full length enumerator is not independently certified.
title: Exact total-domination sequence enumerator for subdivided cliques
